---
title: "About"
---

I am Haiwen Guan, a computational scientist and postdoctoral researcher at Argonne National Laboratory. My work sits at the intersection of AI and scientific computing: neural operators, generative and diffusion models, and AI emulators for weather and climate.

Current projects include LUCIE, an AI atmospheric emulator, and a side project building an AI player for city-building games — starting with the question of which game, and which interface, makes the problem worth studying.

This site is written in Quarto and hosted on GitHub Pages. Posts are mirrored free on Substack. There is no paywall; if the writing ever earns anything, it will be through voluntary donations.
